notes: REST set one location at a time. This takes an array, so a loop becomes one call.
A quantity name and a reason are both required. REST needed neither, so a straight port has to decide what the change was for.

Without ignoreCompareQuantity, the call expects the quantity you believe is current and fails if it has moved. That is a feature, not an obstacle, and it is the correct way to avoid two writers overwriting each other.
The response is an adjustment group describing what changed, not the new level. Code that read the returned level needs rewriting.
